description:
Goal
Remove scaffolding-grade diagnostics from a production projection path.

What
resolve_publication_source_boundaries (jobs/transport.rs:459-472) contains a bare eprintln! for unresolved boundaries. Per "warnings are errors if it is something we control" this stray stderr print must go: either route it through telemetry as a proper diagnostic event or fail-loud (aligns with fz-x2n direction on multi-surface divergence). Decide which against the surrounding contract and remove the eprintln.

Verify
No bare eprintln in jobs/transport.rs; suite green; zero warnings.

comments.text: Stray eprintln! in resolve_publication_source_boundaries was uncommitted working-tree scaffolding layered on the fz-bfh.5 WIP checkpoint (3fe32dbd1), not committed history. Removed it, restoring the prior silent no-resolutions branch. Fail-loud-on-divergence belongs to fz-x2n, not here. Tree clean vs HEAD; shadow==monolith green; zero warnings. No commit required.

title: Cleanup: remove stray eprintln! in resolve_publication_source_boundaries
